- AC2 (closed→in_progress reactivation residual documented and pinned): DONE — documented in the new subsection; pinned by existing test_reactivate_does_not_disturb_open_parent plus new test_close_refused_over_blocked_child (close guard unconditional over blocked children).
- AC3 (blocked→in_progress resolved as DOCUMENTED NON-CASCADING, gate-vs-cascade disagreement reconciled in docs/table comments): DONE — documented in §I4a and the _CASCADING_EDGES comment block; pinned by new test_blocked_resume_does_not_cascade_open_parent.
- AC4 (no behavior change; table rows byte-identical; txn.claim_core untouched): DONE — diff touches only docs, comments/docstrings, and tests; 38/38 cascade tests pass, lint/typecheck/complexity ratchet all green in CI (Verified +1).

Scope stayed within the operator's 2026-08-21 recorded rulings; no new design decisions taken.
